set firewall family inet filter ACCESS-L.command: set firewall family inet filter ACCESS-LIST-2000
set firewall family inet filter ACCESS-L.explanation: This command fragment configures an IPv4 firewall filter named `[parameter1]` in Junos OS, defining rules to control traffic based on specified conditions.

term DENY-10.1.1.1.explanation: This command fragment creates a term within an IPv4 firewall filter, where `[parameter1]` is the filter name and `[parameter2]` is the term name.

from source-address 10.1.1.1.explanation: The command filters traffic based on the specified source IP address (`[parameter3]`), allowing or denying packets originating from that address in a Junos configuration.

then discard.explanation: Configure firewall filter terminologies and accept all traffic.

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: Action, accept indicates acceptance of traffic.

set system login class VTY_CLASS.explanation: This Junos command fragment defines a login class named `[parameter1]`, specifying permissions and access levels for users assigned to this class.

parameters.name: class-name
parameters.explanation: The name of the login class.

idle-timeout 30.explanation: The `idle-timeout` command sets the duration (in seconds) after which an idle session is terminated, with `[parameter2]` specifying the timeout value.

parameters.name: idle-timeout
parameters.explanation: Idle timeout duration, measured in minutes.

allow-commands \".*\".explanation: The command `allow-commands [parameter2]` in Junos permits specific commands (specified by `[parameter2]`) to be executed under a restricted configuration or operational mode.

parameters.name: allow-commands
parameters.explanation: The regular expression for commands that are permitted to be executed.

set system login user vty-user.explanation: This command fragment configures a user account on a Junos device, where `[parameter1]` specifies the username for login authentication and management access.

class VTY_CLASS.explanation: Configure the type of system login user.

authentication plain-text-password \"@%@.explanation: Configure the system login user's authentication as an explicit password.

set system services ssh connection-limit.explanation: The command explanation is: Configure the connection limit for the SSH service.

parameters.name: connection-limit
parameters.explanation: The maximum number of connections for the SSH service.

set system services ssh access-profile A.command: set system services ssh access-profile ACCESS-LIST-2000
set system services ssh access-profile A.explanation: Configure the access control list for the SSH service.

parameters.name: access-profile
parameters.explanation: The name of the access control list.

set access address-assignment pool VTY_P.explanation: This command fragment configures an address-assignment pool named `[parameter1]` for dynamic IP address allocation in Junos.

family inet dhcp-attributes lease-time 1.explanation: The command sets the DHCP lease time for the `inet` address family, specifying the duration (in seconds) that a DHCP client can use an assigned IP address.
